name: Vertical Digital Screen Mockup
summary: PSD mockup of a vertical totem digital screen on a pedestal foot for signage and campaign shots.
description: A vertical digital screen mockup: a rounded-corner totem on a slim pedestal foot. The 75.5 MB PSD (4500x3000 px, 300 dpi) drops artwork onto the screen through a Smart Object and lets you recolor the screen fill and background; a help file is included. Made for indoor digital signage, retail displays, product launches and campaign presentations. Personal use is free; extended use needs the Pro license.
contains: Smart Object for the screen artwork, editable screen fill and background
personal license free, extended license pro
created for Adobe Photoshop (latest Creative Cloud)
